stem.text: A rigid circular disc of radius $r$ has its centre at X. A number of forces of equal magnitude $F$ act at the edge of the disc. All the forces are in the plane of the disc.
Which arrangement of forces provides a moment of magnitude $2Fr$ about X?

A.alt: Circle with a dot labelled X at its centre, with two arrows labelled F on its edge, one pointing upwards and one pointing downwards.

B.alt: Circle with a dot labelled X at its centre, with one arrow labelled F on its edge.

C.alt: Circle with a dot labelled X at its centre, with two arrows labelled F on its edge, both pointing downwards.

D.alt: Circle with a dot labelled X at its centre, with three arrows labelled F on its edge.
